# Life of Adam and Eve Chapter 42 — The LOGOS Bible (Formal)
**Translator:** LOGOS | **Source:** Latin MS (Vita Adae et Evae) | **Section:** Eve Tells the Story of the Fall

---

**1** Eve said: 'Let me tell you all that happened in paradise, so you may know why you suffer toil and pain upon the earth.'

**2** She said: 'In the beginning, God placed your father Adam and me in paradise to tend the garden and keep it.'

**3** 'God gave us every tree to eat from, except one — the tree of the knowledge of good and evil, which stood in the middle of the garden.'

---
*LOGOS: formal equivalence; verse-only numbering.*
